'''rebel router The Rebel Router''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[rebel router]]
* '''Published:''' 29 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: West Gallery|SE-D-cloudcitywestgallery.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City: West Gallery
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Cloud City West Gallery router D.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Uses bounty hunters and stong imperials to overwhelm the opponent.  In space there is a lot of star destroyers and the fighters to back them up.  I'm looking for people to rate this deck to see if I could enter a tournament.RATE ME!!

== Strategy ==

It's actually a very simple strategy. I don't use the bounty hunters to capture anyone because I don't have any prisons.  I pretty much just use strong characters and ships to overwhelm the opponent.  I also use the R1-G4's to increase the hyper drive of executor to be able to move to different battles.
